title: Winter Holiday Data and Trends | 2026 Holiday Consumer Spending Insights | NRF

facts.fact: NRF predicts U.S. retail sales in November and December 2026 will grow 4.2% over 2025.
facts.quote: NRF predicts retail sales in November and December will grow 4.2% over 2025, equating to total spending of $1.013 trillion

facts.fact: According to NRF's holiday survey, 43% of holiday shoppers plan to start holiday shopping before November.
facts.quote: 43% of holiday shoppers plan to start before November

facts.fact: According to NRF's holiday survey, 56% of holiday shoppers say the state of the economy will affect their holiday spending plans.
facts.quote: 56% of holiday shoppers say the state of the economy will affect their holiday spending plans this year

facts.fact: According to NRF's holiday survey, 47% of holiday shoppers would like to receive gift cards this holiday season.
facts.quote: 47% of holiday shoppers say they would like to receive gift cards this holiday season followed by clothing (44%)

facts.fact: According to NRF's holiday survey, 44% of holiday shoppers would like to receive clothing as a gift this holiday season.
facts.quote: followed by clothing (44%), books and other media (25%) and personal care or beauty items (24%)

facts.fact: NRF's forecast expects November and December 2026 holiday sales to grow 4.2% over 2025 (NRF vendor forecast, published Oct 15, 2026).
facts.quote: NRF expects November and December will grow 4.2% over 2025.

facts.fact: NRF reported that the Thanksgiving holiday weekend drew a record 203 million shoppers.
facts.quote: Thanksgiving holiday weekend draws a record 203 million shoppers

facts.fact: NRF reported that 157 million consumers shopped on Super Saturday.
facts.quote: 157 Million Consumers to Shop on Super Saturday

facts.fact: NRF reported that 197 million consumers shopped over the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.
facts.quote: 197 Million Consumers Shop Over Thanksgiving Holiday Weekend
